steps.caption: Open the Lumen Harbour Tech lease from Leases. Its executed deed is already attached.
The note at the top: extracted clauses are shown word for word with page numbers. They are summaries, not legal advice.
Important dates: execution, commencement, lock-in, escalations, break option, notice deadlines and expiry.
Confirmed contractual deadline: someone checked it against the signed deed. Commencement and expiry are confirmed here.
Lock-in completion: Calculated — not verified. It shows the method — 36 months from 1 Jan 2024, minus one day.
And the exact clause it came from, with the document and page number.
A warning: lock-in completion alone does not allow termination — the notice clause still applies.
Checked it against the deed? Add a review note and press Confirm after review.
It is now a Confirmed contractual deadline, with today's date and your note.
Break option says Needs review: its conditions (a break fee) must be checked, so you must pick the date yourself.
Reject removes a wrong date; Add or calculate a date lets you enter one by hand or calculate it from a clause.
Reminders are created only from confirmed dates — here, ahead of the lock-in completion. They appear in the app; nothing is sent outside.
The activity timeline records who confirmed what, and when.
